reviews.author: Joyce
reviews.text:
After visiting several English academies, I came across Reims Young English Study. I wanted to improve my conversation skills without feeling stressed, and I think this is the optimal space for that.👍🏻

1. Good accessibility
2. Relatively cheap tuition
3. Flexibility in taking courses (you can apply on any date and time you want)
4. Conversation and cultural exchange with foreign friends of various nationalities
5. Friendly service
6. You can take classes appropriate for your level.

I've been going for about two months, but I don't think there are any downsides. Personally, as someone who has been speaking English over the phone for a very long time, I think it is definitely more effective to practice speaking face-to-face than over the phone or video. Even if you are at the same level, seeing people who are more fluent is stimulating and most of all, I enjoy the class. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to learn English in a fun way!😋

reviews.author: Yunha Park
reviews.text:
Giovane
A private coffee shop (Giovane) next to Ediya.

I came in to have a cup of coffee before going to Geumchan, and was greeted by a unique coffee taste.
Is it a roasting difference? It's a choice between the two...

It's Polar Beer.
There is acidity, but the first taste is like caramel, and after swallowing, a sour taste lingers in your mouth.
I don't like strong, acidic coffee, but I can drink it without feeling uncomfortable, perhaps because this coffee has a sweet flavor. What's disappointing is that the acidity in the mouth has disappeared and there is a slight bitterness.

And the deep gray flavored coffee I received was strong. There is no acidity, so there is no harshness, but the taste is heavy and dark.

While Polar Beer is a sweet and acidic coffee, Deep Gray is a strong and heavy coffee. The finish is good without any bitterness.

There are so many Chanjeom Coffees that it's hard to find unique coffee, but this restaurant has its own unique flavor.
I like that this place is near Chunghyeon Church. Even though this house has been around for a long time, it has survived the coronavirus well. Has the owner changed? Hmm...

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
After enjoying the Sanga Gimbap at the Gangnam branch, I looked around to see if there was a good take-out coffee shop nearby. I looked on Naver Maps to see if there was a Banapresso, and saw that there was a Banapresso Samsung Town branch not far away, so I decided to visit.

When I arrived in front of the store, it felt already crowded with office workers coming to have a cup of coffee after lunch, as it is a block with many offices around Gangnam Station.

When I entered the store, it had a high ceiling and a deep interior, but it was so full of customers that I thought it was Manhattan, New York.

I waited for my turn at the kiosk and ordered a hot specialty Americano, which is my favorite menu item at this store. The crowded atmosphere was different from the Banapresso near my house that I used to go to, so it felt good.

Rather than the mediocre size of the Customs Intersection branch closest to my house, I would rather have a small and private feel like the Eulji Hospital Intersection branch. Of course, they will open a branch according to the neighborhood, but I like it more because it is larger like the Samsung Town branch here and has several employees constantly making coffee.

Because there were so many customers, I waited for a while and finally my number came up and I picked it up.

When I opened the lid of the coffee cup and smelled it, I liked the scent and taste of specialty Americano with a refreshing acidity.

Banapresso's Specialty Americano uses Ethiopian specialty coffee with a strong acidity, which I like, so it's not only cost-effective, but also tasty and generous in quantity, so I keep coming back for it.

Next time, I plan to try other types of coffee.

reviews.text:
I think it opens around the end of 2025. The interior of the cafe is luxurious and the tables are spacious, so you won't have to listen to other people's conversations. ^^; I thought the coffee would be expensive because it was high-end, but the drinks were cheaper than other places.
They have a signature menu and it’s really delicious. Coffee beans are as delicious as if you used good ones.
After stopping by with a friend, my friend said he keeps buying coffee beans here and drinking them at home.  I stopped by several times and tried everything. There have been no failed menus yet. Our signature menu item, granita, is a taste you can’t find anywhere else! It was really good.

Not long ago, I brought my parents here and had vincho, Goutte Nutspenner, and Americano. Vin Chau is also perfect to drink in winter.

The staff are also friendly. They looked at it carefully. I couldn't find a cafe I liked, so I always ended up going to noisy places, but for the first time in a long time, I think I found a relaxing and comfortable space. ^^

If you visit once, you will probably want to come again.
I hope this cafe stays around for a long time. I ate deliciously and rested comfortably~ ^^

reviews.author: Shinsuui
reviews.text:
My review was deleted so I am leaving it again.
Please make sure to train your employees.
It was 3-4 months ago
The store was large and there were no signs for restrooms, so I asked the employee about the restrooms.
I didn't even pretend to listen until I asked 3 times.
He was waving his hand and saying, ‘Go to the temple.’
The voice I couldn't hear was full of frustration.
It's so absurd that I'm speechless.
I went to the bathroom and it seemed like the drink I ordered came out, so I thought, 'Is this the right one for me?'
When I asked him, he sighed and said, ‘What time is it? Yes, that's it'
There was no kindness at all.
It was a female employee who was a bit fat and wore glasses.
Are you still working?!
Jinjang not only has customers, but also employees.
I know that the service profession is a stressful one, and I also experienced that time.
If possible, I try to just skip it.
Even thinking about it now makes me angry.
There were other customers and I just passed by quietly.
I plan to go again as I remember.
But let’s see each other then and again.

The place is spacious and comfortable. It's a good place to eat and have small talk, but not suitable for studying or long conversations. It appears that it was originally created for the convenience of meetings for people working in this building.

Still, if you are used to Starbucks, where the existing seats are narrow, stuffy, and dark, I think this is a place where you can have a new experience. First of all, the space between seats is very wide and there are many large sofas, so the seats are comfortable. The space is wide and the ceiling is high, so it feels less spacious or crowded. It's not a place you'd want to stop by, but it's worth a visit if you're nearby.

reviews.text:
Labrique is a place where you can enjoy a special brunch.
​The eggs Benedict here stands out for its specialness, different from the usual brunch. The rich hollandaise sauce, sausage, smoked paprika, dried tomatoes, and ragu sauce are in perfect harmony, and the French fries served on the side are also good.
​French toast has a fluffy texture and a variety of flavors with pea cream, bacon, sausage, and blueberries. You can end your meal neatly with a sweet banana brûlée.
​The interior is spacious and clean, and the terrace in particular has an open feel, making it a good place to spend time comfortably.
Totally recommended.

reviews.text: It’s the perfect place to have brunch with friends in Gangnam! The price was reasonable and the food quality was really good. The outdoor terrace seating was beautiful and the seats on the second floor inside were also nice. We went for brunch on the weekend and it was a bit crowded so there were only 2 people waiting, but people kept coming in around lunch time. I recommend going a little early. Oh, and it's on a hill, so use a map and head towards the gentle slope~!

America is expensive at 6,000 won, but considering the cafe atmosphere and sensibility, it is reasonable.

reviews.author: Denne
reviews.text: I had the original French toast at Cafe Fratelli in Gangnam Station, and it's a real Pto restaurant.👍 Because it's fluffy, it cuts easily with a butter knife, isn't overly sweet, and doesn't have any eggy smell at all! I recommend ordering coffee or tea and eating it together☺️

reviews.author: Jolie Ahn
reviews.text:
The pudding-like French toast, which is good as a meal or dessert, is delicious and impressive, something you've never experienced anywhere else.

The latte was made with specialty coffee beans and milk, so it had a nice, nutty taste. As a bonus, my mood improved with latte art.

This is a place where you can comfortably eat, drink, and enjoy different charms on each floor between Gangnam Station and Shinnonhyeon Station. The top rooftop is the most attractive floor.

reviews.author: Jiyoung Lee
reviews.text:
Wow the toast is delicious
It's perfect with Americano. I like the interior and music selection. I'll be a regular

reviews.author: senie
reviews.text:
I guess I had too high expectations for the toast. It didn't taste great considering it was expensive.
The store has multiple floors, so there was relatively plenty of seating.

reviews.author: senie
reviews.text: It's a cafe with a warm, old-fashioned atmosphere. It's quite spacious, so the space between seats is wide, so it's good for conversation. The owner was also very friendly, so I felt good. The downside was that it felt a little damp because it was in the basement.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text: It's a bit noisy when there are a lot of people, but it's very nice. Most of the tabletops are low, so it's better to come here for conversation rather than work.

reviews.author: Mullae-dongNamcheon-dong
reviews.text:
A cafe with a slightly enlightened(?) feel.
It looks like they're using antique furniture, but it doesn't have that distinctive old-fashioned smell. The menu has a unique rice cake crop.

reviews.author: Isaac
reviews.text: The drinks were delicious in a cozy atmosphere. Everything was good except the drinks were expensive. I think I'll stop by again while passing by.

reviews.author: Juy
reviews.text: I can't believe there's a place like this hidden in Gangnam. The atmosphere is amazing. However, when there are a lot of people, it is a bit noisy and echoes. I recommend going during quiet times.

reviews.author: Luna Kang
reviews.text: Truly the best cafe in Gangnam! The owner is very kind. You should have made a reservation for the rooftop, but since it was before Chuseok, there were no people, so he let us just use it!! The drinks are really delicious too!! I definitely go here when I go to Gangnam♡♡♡♡♡

reviews.author: Woojun Jung
reviews.text: It's quiet, spacious and nice. The coffee is delicious too.

reviews.author: Calvin Law
reviews.text:
The place is amazing. The food and the drinks are pretty good but the best part is that there are two dogs living on the premise! One husky and one doodle retriever mix. The staff was super nice and although didn't speak English, they can understand.

This cafe was recently opened and so the roof was not finished renovating but the owner allowed us to have a sneak peak and it looks like it would be amazing when the weather gets warmer.

There are multiple themes throughout the cafe. A full studio you can rent out. Piano and guitar you can play. Classroom you can rent out! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text: Friendly people and building staff!

reviews.author: Sohyun Kim
reviews.text:
It was a cafe I stopped by after eating nearby... oh my...
I can't even think of going up to the second floor. I was also surprised by the steep stairs... having to carry a tray up and down...
And the space is neither luxurious nor pretty.
I'm not sure if the service is friendly. It's not like they're serving you...
My first impression of the drinks and desserts was “too expensive.” Are these foods of this quality for this price? Is space rental fee included? Is this an amount that makes you think for a while? But I don't think the coffee tastes good. I don't think the coffee beans are good. Only the Haagen-Dazs vanilla flavor ice cream was delicious.
I don't think I'll need to visit again.

reviews.author: A N
reviews.text:
It's just pretty, but not luxurious. The various distracting new menu promotion posts and drink promotion paper placed at each seat were also annoying. As other reviews say, I'm not sure if the coffee is delicious. You may feel anxious going up the stairs because you can see the floor in small detail at each step.

It's just an ornamental cafe, nothing more or less.
The strawberry cake costs 11.9 and the pieces are very small. Animal whipped cream... it tastes good, but the price is ridiculous. I thought it would be like that until Americano 6.0. Starting with the latte, it seemed to have jumped close to 8.0.

I didn't like the sentiment a bit.
The chandelier also feels sketchy.

*The restroom is on the second floor, with one stall for men and two stalls for women. A total of three private bathrooms have a ‘ㅗ’ shaped structure. I felt uncomfortable doing my business by attaching a sheet bordering between opaque and transparent to the transparent glass door. Among the women's restrooms, the front bathroom had a toilet on the right, so there was no chance of the other person seeing me, but the bathroom on the right had a door right in front, so I was concerned.

I thought there were a lot of desserts, but there were not many and I don't plan on visiting again. The nearby First Coffee Lab or Kraft Cafe are better.
The staff are also cynical.

reviews.author: Gyugyu
reviews.text:
A strawberry bouquet parfait with great visuals!!! 🍓
It's even more delicious with Häagen-Dazs ice cream.
The price is 17,000, which is not easy, but I forgot about it while eating delicious food.

The cafe's high ceilings and spacious space make it great for conversation.
The bathroom is clean, so it’s a convenient place to stay!!

reviews.author: Park Kyung-ho
reviews.text: I was surprised that there were no people, the seats were widely spaced, it was quiet, and there was a large cafe on the second floor in Gangnam. This cafe is perfect for a date. However, the food itself is not very good. It's a cafe that feels like you're just renting a space. Does it feel like you added granola to a mango parfait and fried it up? Still good for a date

reviews.author: Yongsuk Sung
reviews.text: Coffee, tea, and cake all taste average and the prices are very high, but the service level is not that high. It was absurd that they encouraged me to leave before business hours ended so they could clean up the place.

address: 810-9, 1st floor, Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Bae Tae-cheon
reviews.text:
Located in the middle of Gangnam Food Alley
In a very crowded space like a coffee shop
You can have a little bit of quiet
The location was good.

Store atmosphere, coffee and waffles
I enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Kim Se-yoon
reviews.text: Although there aren't many reviews, the atmosphere is nice and it's not crowded, so I like it. You can see the alley scenery outside the window, and it seems to have a unique atmosphere that you can't find in other cafes around here.

reviews.author: Jihyun Lee
reviews.text: 4th floor, including terrace, located in the back alley of Gangnam Main Street. The entire building itself is a cafe. Originally, there were few people compared to the square footage, size, and location. It was crowded today, perhaps because it was the weekend. The price is not very cheap, but it is not too expensive either. Orders and waiting times were long today, but not during weekday afternoon hours. It's a pretty cafe that's cost-effective and not bad.

reviews.author: Solbi Kwon
reviews.text:
The price is quite expensive. I think it's because it's Gangnam... but it's still expensive ㅠㅠ
But be sure to eat the waffles, they’re delicious.
It's nothing else but waffles. This is a great waffle restaurant.

reviews.author: Chase a Legend
reviews.text:
I visited this place while visiting my home country in South America, and I had a new, exotic feeling as I tasted high-quality coffee in a comfortable facility and an indoor environment that can only be experienced at high-end coffee houses in South America.
A cafe I would definitely recommend.
